content: The test image shows soybean leaves with multiple angular-to-irregular brown/tan lesions scattered across all leaflets, with distinct yellow/chlorotic areas surrounding some necrotic regions. Let me compare with a reference.

- Multiple irregular/angular brown-tan lesions scattered across all three leaflets
- Significant yellow/chlorotic halos surrounding the necrotic areas
- Lesions vary in size and appear to be coalescing in some areas
- Affects mid-canopy leaves

**Comparison with Bacterial_Blight reference:**
The reference shows smaller, distinct spots with yellow-green halos — early stage. The test image appears to show more advanced Bacterial_Blight where lesions have coalesced into larger irregular necrotic areas with broad yellow-green halos, exactly as described: *"lesions may coalesce to form large, irregularly shaped lesions"* with *"yellowish-green halo around lesions."*

The angular shape of lesions, prominent yellow haloes, and mid-canopy distribution strongly match Bacterial_Blight over alternatives like Septoria_brown_spot (which typically starts lower canopy with angular red-brown spots without prominent yellow halos) or Frogeye (which shows circular spots with reddish-purple borders).
